title: ProofPatch: Reviewing Lean Statements and Keeping the Reviews Valid as Formalizations Evolve
title_zh: ProofPatch：审阅 Lean 陈述并使审阅结论随形式化演进而保持有效

paragraphs.en: ProofPatch帮助审阅Lean陈述并在形式化演进中保持审阅结论有效，可精确标记不忠实陈述并阻止违规修改。 The kernel of the Lean proof assistant checks that a proof establishes its statement. Whether the statement says what was intended is left to human reviewers. This is the old problem of validating a specification, and it grows more pressing as language models write formal statements in bulk and agents edit formal developments continuously. We present ProofPatch, a tool that helps reviewers judge Lean statements and keeps their judgments valid while the development changes. A reviewer can ask the kernel targeted questions about a statement, such as whether a hypothesis is needed or whether a counterexample exists. Each decision is stored with fingerprints of the statement as Lean elaborated it and of the definitions it depends on, and any declaration can be pinned so that a patch changing it is blocked, whether a person or an agent built on a large language model (LLM) wrote the patch. Working on elaborated terms rather than source text is the central design choice: notation and formatting changes leave a decision intact, and a changed definition reaches every theorem that uses it. On 229 pairs of consecutive revisions of Mathlib, Lean's mathematics library, ProofPatch sends 118 of 12,898 synthetic decisions back for review. Every text-based alternative misses at least 38 of these or sends back at least 13 times as many. On 1,527 labeled statements, kernel evidence flags unfaithful ones with precision 0.88 to 0.96, and in 344 runs of an LLM agent no change to a pinned statement got through.
paragraphs.zh: ProofPatch 帮助审阅 Lean 陈述并在形式化演进中保持审阅结论有效，可精确标记不忠实陈述并阻止违规修改。Lean 证明助手的内核检查证明是否确立了其陈述。 陈述是否表达了本意则留给人类审阅者判断。 这是验证规格说明的古老问题，随着语言模型批量撰写形式化陈述、智能体持续编辑形式化开发，它变得愈发紧迫。 我们提出 ProofPatch，这是一个帮助审阅者判断 Lean 陈述并在开发变更时保持其判断有效的工具。 审阅者可以向内核就一个陈述提出有针对性的问题，例如某个假设是否必要，或是否存在反例。 每个决策都与该陈述经 Lean 精化后的指纹及其所依赖定义的指纹一同存储，并且任何声明都可以被固定，从而阻止修改它的补丁——无论该补丁是由人还是由基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体编写的。 以精化后的项而非源文本为操作对象是核心设计选择：记号与格式的改动不会影响已有决策，而定义的变更会波及每一个使用它的定理。 在 Mathlib（Lean 的数学库）的 229 对连续修订上，ProofPatch 将 12,898 个合成决策中的 118 个送回复审。 每种基于文本的替代方案要么漏掉其中至少 38 个，要么送回复审的数量至少多 13 倍。 在 1,527 个带标注的陈述上，内核证据以 0.88 到 0.96 的精确率标记出不忠实陈述，并且在 344 次 LLM 智能体运行中，没有任何对被固定陈述的修改得以通过。
